corrections.reason: The word split across L28-L29 is ገሥግሣ ('hastening early'), with 1st-order ገ clearly visible before ሥግ.
Accusative object marker ሻሹን ('the headcloth') has 6th-order ን on the page.
Stage-1 OCR output an Arabic character instead of Ethiopic 6th-order ጥ completing ሳይቀመጥ።
Both verbs are plural 3rd-person masculine (ወርእዩ ወአምኑ) in this Ge'ez text, matching the plural Amharic gloss አይተው አመኑ in L22 and the visible right-side vowel strokes on ዩ and ኑ.
Classical Ge'ez perfective stem አእመሩ with negative prefix ኢ- contracts to ኢያእመሩ (4th-order ያ), which is clearly printed on the page.
Classical Ge'ez 3rd-person singular perfective verb is አስተርአየ ('how Jesus appeared to Mary Magdalene') with 1st-order የ.
